_readme: Every parameter has a value, a status and a note. status = missing (site or lab data not yet supplied: fill the matching CSV in inputs/), placeholder (assumed value, replace when known), literature (published value), design (our choice), measured (from our own data). Soil and rock values start empty: run_all.py lays out the plots, then stops and lists the input files it still needs.

site_dir.note: QGIS layers exported from Lomba_da_Maia_Plots_v2 (EPSG:5015 for rasters, WGS84 for vectors)

candidate_units.note: Contiguous pilot units rated Easy/Workable with slope p90 under 20%. Change here to test other areas

max_plot_slope_pct.note: Mean slope limit per plot, for safe spreading and even runoff

max_cell_slope_pct.note: Pixels steeper than this are excluded

drainage_buffer_m.note: No-spread buffer either side of drainage lines (4 ha+ catchment)

plot_length_m.note: Square plots pack best into the open ground of U3 to U5

plot_width_m.note: Five 16 m spreading bouts; plots are 0.64 ha gross

net_inset_m.note: Sampling only inside the plot minus this inset, to avoid edge drift

seed.note: Random seed for rate allocation; record it in the trial protocol

blocks.note: Blocks laid along the elevation gradient. 3 blocks = 12 plots (minimum); 4 = 16 plots (recommended if screening variability is medium or high)

sampling_months.note: Soil sampling rounds; 0 = baseline before spreading

individual_cores_per_plot.note: Cores analysed separately each round for the tracer mass balance and its uncertainty

depths_cm.note: 0-10 every round; 10-20 and 20-30 at 0, 12 and 30 months

mean_temp_C.note: About 15 C at 350-450 m on the NE coast; replace with IPMA / CIIMAR or a farm logger

rain_mm_yr.note: NE Sao Miguel at trial elevation; replace with station data

pH_H2O.note: Fill from inputs/soil_screening.csv (pH_H2O, mean of composites). Andosol under dairy pasture

bulk_density_g_cm3.note: Fill from inputs/soil_screening.csv (bulk_density_g_cm3). Andosols are light (0.6 to 0.9)

mixing_depth_cm.note: Surface application, no tillage: rock stays in the top 10 cm at first

pH_buffer_cmolc_kg_pH.note: Fill from inputs/soil_screening.csv (pH_buffer_cmolc_kg_pH, titration on composites). Andic soils buffer strongly

acid_load_keq_ha_yr.note: Fill from inputs/site_other.csv (acid_load_keq_ha_yr, from farm N and lime records). Net background acidity from N fertiliser and grazing after the farm's routine liming

exchange_retention_frac.note: Share of non-bicarbonate cations held on the exchange complex rather than leached with strong-acid anions

secondary_loss_frac.note: Released cations lost to secondary minerals and clays

plant_uptake_frac.note: Ca and Mg removed in grazed or cut grass

elements.note: Fill from inputs/soil_screening.csv (total elements: CaO_pct ... V_ppm). Soil total element concentrations (fusion XRF / ICP)

heterogeneity_cv.note: Fill from inputs/soil_cores.csv (individually analysed cores, grouped). Core-to-core coefficient of variation within a plot

between_plot_sd.note: Derived by run_all.py from inputs/soil_screening.csv (0.5 x between-composite SD; needs 4 or more composites). SD of the 30-month change between plots treated alike

analytical_cv.note: Fill from inputs/site_other.csv (analytical_cv, from lab duplicates and reference materials). Lab precision

oxides_pct.note: Fill from inputs/feedstock_xrf.csv (oxides in wt%). Tecnovia fines, lab XRF

total_S_pct.note: Fill from inputs/feedstock_other.csv (total_S_pct). Sulfide S can generate acidity (2 eq per mol S)

trace_ppm.note: Fill from inputs/feedstock_xrf.csv (trace elements in ppm, ICP-MS)

moisture_wet_frac.note: Fill from inputs/feedstock_other.csv (moisture_wet_frac). Water content, ISO 17892-1, wet basis

mineral_mode_wt_frac.note: Fill from inputs/feedstock_xrd.csv. Quantitative XRD with glass by difference

psd_mass_frac.note: Fill from inputs/feedstock_psd.csv. Unmilled 0-4 mm quarry fines

roughness.note: Reactive / geometric surface ratio. BET will refine this

_source.value: Palandri and Kharaka (2004) USGS OFR 2004-1068 for crystalline phases; basaltic glass approximated from Gislason and Oelkers (2003)
_source.note: Rate = k_acid * aH^n + k_neutral, Arrhenius-corrected to site temperature

glass.formula: Basaltic glass per mol Si; cations by difference

minerals.note: Glass values are an approximation: flag for Juan

field_factor.note: Lab-to-field scaling (wetting, contact, armouring). Calibrate with mesocosms and the first field rounds

downstream_retention.note: Share of exported bicarbonate alkalinity that stays as stored carbon after river and ocean re-equilibration; Isometric uses a site-specific deduction, confirm the value used

haul_km.note: Rabo de Peixe quarry to Lomba da Maia, one way

quarry_allocation_kgCO2e_per_t.note: Zero only if fines are a by-product not produced for sale; depends on Tecnovia's fate-of-fines answer and Isometric allocation rules

soil_limits_mg_kg.note: Portuguese soil limit values for sludge application (Decreto-Lei 276/2009, Annex I) used as a screening reference only. Confirm with Juan and the regional authority which thresholds apply to rock dust; volcanic soils can exceed Ni and Cr naturally

soil_height_cm.note: Repacked by horizon (0-10, 10-20, 20-30) from the trial area

rates_t_ha.note: 160 t/ha extends the curve beyond the field

sand_controls.note: Basalt in acid-washed quartz sand at 40 t/ha: rock-only dissolution rate

irrigation_mm_yr.note: Site drainage (rain minus AET), applied weekly as artificial rain

alkalinity_loq_meq_L.note: Gran titration LOQ; confirm with lab
